visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, wearing a white quilted vest over a cream sweater, stares intensely at her mahjong tiles in a dimly lit room with purple and red ambient lighting. (2) The camera cuts to a medium shot of the four-player mahjong table where purple smoke effects swirl around the players. Another woman in a tan hoodie confidently plays a tile. (3) A young man with bleached blonde hair and simulated bruises on his forehead and cheek is shown in a tight close-up; he wears a dark suit jacket and appears focused, placing a small yellow snack in his mouth. (4) Close-ups of the automatic mahjong table's internal mechanisms and tiles being shuffled; the man's eyes are digitally altered to glow with a bright yellow-green light. (5) A woman in a blue denim jacket, also with simulated bruises on her face, watches the man with a shocked expression as high-contrast red lighting emphasizes the dramatic tension. (6) Another woman’s eyes glow a menacing red as she smiles at her hand of tiles. (7) The man reveals his winning hand, but eventually collapses forward onto the table in exhaustion. (8) The video concludes with a black screen containing white 'To be continued' text and a detailed scrolling credit list featuring social media handles and production roles.

(2) A sharp percussive 'clack' triggers a shift to a male voice speaking with high volume and strained intensity; he sounds aggressive and authoritative. (3) Continuous mid-frequency whirring of an automatic table is overlaid with rhythmic electronic music at approximately 128 BPM. (4) A female voice laughs briefly, followed by a 'whoosh' transition sound effect. (5) As the man explains his move, the BGM tension increases with high spectral brightness. (6) Sudden impact SFX coincides with the man revealed as 'God Hand K'. (7) The final phase features an upbeat electronic pop track with high percussive density as the credits roll.
